Official Document Services in India: 5 Trusted Portals You Should Know

India runs its document services through a small set of official portals.

3 min read•

Last updated: 2 Oct 2026

S
Samjho Content Team
Finance and policy experts with 5+ years of experience helping Indians understand money, documents and government schemes.

Quick Summary

India runs its document services through a small set of official portals. This guide covers all 5 of them — from DigiLocker's digital wallet to State certificate listings. You will also learn where to register a birth or death and how to check if a website is really a government site.

India issues and stores your government documents across a few trusted online portals. Your Aadhaar, PAN, driving licence, marksheets and certificates do not sit in one place. Different departments issue them, and different portals hold them.

Knowing the right portal saves you time and keeps you away from fake websites.

What These Services Do

These 5 services cover digital storage, birth and death records, official PDFs, ministry directories and State certificates. Each one has a fixed job. You only need to pick the one that matches your work.

The 5 Official Portals

1. DigiLocker – your digital document wallet

This is a government-run wallet for documents you have already been issued. You can keep Aadhaar, PAN, driving licence and marksheets in it. Documents pulled from the issuing department are treated as valid copies under the IT Act.

That means they work like the originals for most official purposes. Portal: digilocker.gov.in

2. Birth and death registration – Central and State

This listing takes you to your own State's registration system. It works under the Registrar General of India. You must register a birth or death within 21 days of the event.

Certified copies help with school admission, passports and legal work. Portal: services.india.gov.in

3. Government documents directory – Central

This is a hand-picked list of government documents, policies, Acts and public papers. You can download official PDFs of schemes and guidelines here. You do not need to hunt through many ministry websites.

Portal: india.gov.in/my-government/documents

4. Government web directory – Central and State

This is the official list of central ministries, departments, State governments and UT administrations. Every entry links to that department's verified website. Use it to confirm a site is genuine before you share any details.

Portal: india.gov.in/directory

5. State and UT document services – State and UT

Here you can browse certificate services State by State. You will find ration cards, caste certificates, land records and licences listed. Each entry links to the official State portal, so your application reaches the right office.

Portal: india.gov.in/services/state

Which Portal Should You Use?

  • To store documents digitally, go to DigiLocker.
  • To register a birth or death, go to the NGSP services listing.
  • To find official government documents, go to National Portal Documents.
  • To check a ministry website is real, go to the National Portal Directory.
  • To find State certificate services, go to National Portal State/UT Services.

Key Points

  • DigiLocker holds legally valid digital copies of your issued documents.
  • Birth and death registration is compulsory within 21 days of the event.
  • The National Portal documents section hosts official policies, Acts and scheme PDFs.
  • Always confirm a ministry website through the India.gov.in directory first.
  • Ration cards, caste certificates and land records come through your State's portal.
  • Register a birth within 21 days. A late registration needs a magisterial process.
  • Register a death within 21 days, as per the Registration of Births and Deaths Act.
  • DigiLocker copies get updated by issuing departments as and when they issue documents. No fixed deadline applies.

Benefits

  • DigiLocker keeps your Aadhaar, PAN, driving licence and marksheets in one government-verified wallet.
  • Copies taken from DigiLocker count as legally valid under the IT Act, just like the originals for most official work.
  • The National Portal documents section gives you official PDFs of schemes, Acts and guidelines in one place.
  • The National Portal directory links you to verified ministry and State government websites, so you avoid look-alike sites.
  • State service pages take you straight to the official State portal for ration cards, caste certificates and land records.

How to Apply

  1. For digital copies of issued documents, open DigiLocker at digilocker.gov.in and fetch them from the issuing department.
  2. For a birth or death certificate, go to the services.india.gov.in listing and open your State's registration system.
  3. You can also register a birth or death at your municipal registrar's office.
  4. For official policies and PDFs, visit india.gov.in/my-government/documents.
  5. For State certificates like ration cards or caste certificates, open india.gov.in/services/state and pick your State or UT.

Important Dates

  1. Birth registration is compulsory within 21 days of the birth. Delayed registration needs a magisterial process.
  2. Death registration is compulsory within 21 days of the death, as per the Registration of Births and Deaths Act.
  3. DigiLocker documents are updated by issuer departments when they issue them. No fixed deadline applies.

Common Mistakes

  • Do not trust look-alike websites. Real government sites use .gov.in or .nic.in domains.
  • Check any ministry site against the official directory at india.gov.in/directory before you use it.
  • Do not miss the 21-day window for birth or death registration, or you will need a longer process.
  • Do not apply for State certificates on random sites. Use your State's official portal linked from india.gov.in/services/state.
  • Do not assume all documents sit in one portal. Different services handle different documents.

FAQs

Is DigiLocker accepted as original documents?
Yes. Documents you share from DigiLocker are treated as legally valid copies under the IT Act. For most official purposes, they work the same as the original.
How do I register a birth in India?
Apply through your State's registration system, linked from services.india.gov.in, or visit your municipal registrar. Registering within 21 days is free. After that, you need an affidavit process.
Where can I find official government policies and PDFs?
Use the National Portal documents directory at india.gov.in/my-government/documents. It links to official ministry documents, so you avoid third-party sites.
How do I find my State's certificate services?
Open india.gov.in/services/state and select your State or UT. It links to official portals for ration cards, caste certificates, land records and more.
How do I check whether a website is a real government site?
Check it against the official directory at india.gov.in/directory. Real government sites use .gov.in or .nic.in domains. Look-alike sites often use similar names with different endings.
